summary: Italian, French, Polish and Japanese criticism adds stylistic reservations, version distinctions, neglected authors and specific narrative analysis. One scholarly abstract is explicitly limited to reception/adaptation.
next: Reduce Italian-platform concentration with additional regions and source families.

sources.title: Anna Maria Ortese
sources.note: Sironi connects fractured syntax and visionary narrative with vulnerability, loss and care across Ortese’s novels.
sources.location: Main essay, syntax and concluding novel comparisons
sources.limits: Interpretive appreciation; not an independent ranking.

sources.title: I Promessi Sposi: un libro parallelo
sources.note: Cortellessa reconstructs disagreement over Catholic propaganda, social power and historical complexity in Manzoni, including Moravia’s accusation and Gadda’s rebuttal.
sources.limits: Quoted historical critics are mediated through this essay, not separately consulted sources.

targets.A: Contested reception of a canonical novel.
targets.L: Religious ideology versus formal and historical complexity.

sources.title: Une initiation à l’Afrique ambigüe
sources.note: Mazauric praises Tchak’s nuanced ethnographic satire but finds Safiatou’s motivation insufficiently developed within the self-centered narrator’s perspective.
candidates: Le continent du Tout et du presque Rien
sources.location: Review opening and paragraphs on three-part structure/Safiatou
sources.limits: Recent acclaim cannot establish long-term endurance.

sources.title: Arbasino e i primi Fratelli d’Italia
sources.note: Narros distinguishes the brisk spoken language of Arbasino’s original novel from Gadda’s multilingual style, emphasizing major changes across successive versions.
sources.location: Opening version history and stylistic comparison
sources.limits: 1963 and 1993 versions differ substantially; assessments are edition-sensitive.

targets.L: Voice, pace and relation to Italian modernism.

sources.title: Gaddabolario: furugozzo di parole
sources.note: Castronuovo treats Gadda’s difficulty as a source of comic pleasure and assesses a collaborative dictionary explaining his lexical inventions.
candidates: Quer pasticciaccio brutto de via Merulana
sources.location: Review on linguistic estrangement and dictionary structure
sources.limits: Dictionary entries are not separately consulted; enthusiasm coexists with demands on readers.

targets.N: Appraisal of the Gaddabolario reference work.

sources.title: 12 polskich książek, które sprawią, że staniesz się innym człowiekiem
sources.note: Biełow contrasts Schulz’s vitality with Kafka, praises Hłasko’s speech rhythms and Gombrowicz’s style, and reads Solaris through limits of self-knowledge.
candidates: Sanatorium Under the Sign of the Hourglass
The First Step in the Clouds
sources.location: Schulz, Hłasko, Gombrowicz and Solaris sections
sources.limits: Cultural-promotion institution and personal selection; numbered count is not merit order.

sources.title: 『草枕』—中野翠による書評
sources.note: Nakano finds Sōseki’s famous rhetoric over-polished on rereading, while valuing the conflict between aesthetic detachment, social life and intrusive self-consciousness.
sources.location: Reviewer text, paragraphs on rhetoric and nonattachment
sources.limits: Reprinted review collected in a 2010 book; 2020 web date is not original judgment.

targets.L: Canonical prestige tested against adult reading experience.

sources.title: Od powieści filozoficznej do teatru (post)epickiego? Kosmos Witolda Gombrowicza w inscenizacji Jerzego Jarockiego
sources.note: Gołos-Dąbrowska’s abstract argues Jarocki’s adaptation preserves epic elements of Cosmos and uses staging to activate philosophical interpretation.
sources.limits: Abstract only; stagecraft does not establish novel merit. Full Polish argument remains unread.

targets.A: Evidence of a novel’s interpretive afterlife.
targets.L: Adaptability and active reception, narrowly supported.
